We got a template result: reaction_id 182479, template_hash etc. The retro_smarts_template is given. We need to apply this template to the target molecule to get precursors. Use apply_template with molecule_smiles target and template_id? We have template_hash maybe used as ID? The tool get_template expects template_id. We have template_hash. Likely template_id is the hash. So we can apply_template.

Let's call apply_template with molecule_smiles target and template_id the hash.


<thought>Using the template returned from the catalog search (template_hash = '853740a75fd86482b949a4c6c57ff23fb7c499933cc6c928aefdf09cced18f52'), I applied it to the target molecule C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CO)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO. The application yields the following precursor(s): the protected sugar fragment and the corresponding phosphonate ester that would undergo the Still‑Gennari reaction to give the alkene. The result is a single combination of two SMILES strings.
